execution_shape.response_root_creation: exclusive creation only after independent geometry PASS and successor activation

geometry_materialization.background: nine deterministic non-planar fronto-parallel rectangle meshes behind the target plus a far fill plane; no other moving object
geometry_materialization.target_mesh: fronto-parallel rectangle mesh with two triangles and fixed material coordinates
geometry_materialization.render_input_identity: cluster seed, background mesh, target mesh at frame, camera world_from_camera pose, intrinsic and CLEAN operator
geometry_materialization.persistent_audit_points: fixed 5x5 target material grid excluding rectangle boundary, audited for all 602 frames in every arm
geometry_materialization.pre_response_gate: independent control-only geometry receipt must PASS before any response directory exists

full_scene_pair_reduction.candidate: the final unchanged R3 rotation-compensated track collection after unchanged support-manager splicing
full_scene_pair_reduction.geometry_filter: same source material point is finite, bilinear-safe, same object and z-buffer-visible at current actual endpoint; baseline and oracle use the exact intersection
full_scene_pair_reduction.cell_membership: fixed by previous/source point in unchanged 3x3 grid
full_scene_pair_reduction.per_channel_fit: independent unchanged R3 local affine refit with unchanged minimum 12 tracks, hull, condition and residual rules
full_scene_pair_reduction.pair_evaluable: unchanged R3 pair is evaluable and at least 5 of 9 cells are jointly evaluable after the geometry-valid paired refits
full_scene_pair_reduction.signed_pair_value: median of signed expansion over jointly evaluable cells
full_scene_pair_reduction.absolute_pair_value: median of abs(cell expansion) over jointly evaluable cells; never abs(median(cell expansion))

target_mask_pair_reduction.admission: source object_id=1001 and the identical source-known target material point is visible as object_id=1001 at its actual current endpoint
target_mask_pair_reduction.support: baseline and oracle use the identical target-track intersection; background tracks and cells are forbidden
target_mask_pair_reduction.cell_membership: fixed by previous/source target point in the unchanged 3x3 grid
target_mask_pair_reduction.per_channel_fit: independent unchanged local affine fit with the same minimum 12 tracks and all unchanged fit parameters
target_mask_pair_reduction.pair_evaluable: the corresponding full-scene pair is evaluable and at least 1 target-supported cell is jointly evaluable in baseline and oracle
target_mask_pair_reduction.signed_pair_value: median of signed expansion over the jointly evaluable target-supported cells
target_mask_pair_reduction.absolute_pair_value: median of abs(cell expansion) over the jointly evaluable target-supported cells
target_mask_pair_reduction.reason_for_separate_cell_count: the frozen target occupies only a bounded subset of the full 3x3 grid; this is a mask reduction, not a change to R3 full-scene evaluability

sequence_reduction.signed_p50_p90: type-7 over evaluable signed pair values
sequence_reduction.absolute_p50_p90: type-7 over evaluable absolute pair values
sequence_reduction.coverage_numerator: paired evaluable pairs for the arm and required channel

arm_roles.STATIC_SCENE: required coverage and reported negative-control diagnostic; no additional routing threshold
arm_roles.EGO_ROTATION_STATIC_SCENE: required coverage and must-pass rotation boundary
arm_roles.EGO_TRANSLATION_STATIC_SCENE: required coverage and translation signed plus absolute estimands
arm_roles.OBJECT_APPROACH_STATIC_CAMERA: required target-mask coverage and positive-control retention
arm_roles.OBJECT_APPROACH_PLUS_EGO_6DOF: required target-mask coverage and positive-control retention

routing_precedence: Any geometry, identity, binding, firewall, schema, required coverage, local-fit or rotation-boundary failure => B_ORACLE_NOT_EVALUABLE
Otherwise either positive-control arm passes fewer than 6 of 8 clusters, or signed suppression is positive in fewer than 4 of 8 clusters => STOP_OR_DOWNGRADE_RCLE
Otherwise both positive controls pass and signed suppression is positive in at least 4 of 8, but any GO condition misses => FREEZE_AS_CONDITIONAL_RESIDUAL_FEATURE

Otherwise signed suppression is positive in at least 6 of 8, its cluster median is strictly positive, absolute suppression is at least 0.5 in at least 6 of 8, and both positive arms pass at least 6 of 8 => GO_SINGLE_TARGETED_UPGRADE

positive_control_boundary.baseline_at_or_below_0_01: evaluable scientific nonpass with null ratio; not missingness
